meta.dataset: HYDE 3.3 (History Database of the Global Environment), 1900 AD grids
meta.publisher: Utrecht University / PBL Netherlands Environmental Assessment Agency
meta.citation: Klein Goldewijk, K. (2023). History Database of the Global Environment 3.3. Utrecht University.
meta.licence: CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), per the HYDE 3.3 readme
meta.method: even-odd scanline fill of decoded province rings at row centres; an overlapping cell goes to the smaller province (lower id on equal area); uncovered non-empty cells go to the nearest covered cell within 3 cells
meta.use: within-country shares only; country totals remain the authored OWID/Maddison values (D-121)
